model.name: f1-deposit-campaign
model.method: live air feed -> Law-2396 stamped deposit (kappa=1 arm) or classical composition (kappa=0 arm) -> forward XRF spectrum -> classical sniffer inversion -> falsifier conditions

notes: cache is fresh (age 0.8 min <= TTL 360.0 min); no network call made

sampling.note: sniffer trunk constants; the declared collection geometry of every session

checks.statement: classical arm (kappa=0) reads Au below the 3-sigma MDL
declared arm (kappa=1) reads Au above the 3-sigma MDL
declared deposit matches the law's 9.2 ug (24 h)
the inversion recovers the stamped Au areal
headroom at the declared MDL is the law's ~2.89e4 (gains teeth under a nonzero classical term; a dust=0 live feed stamps the bare floor exactly)

payload.verdict: F1 IN-CODE: FALSIFIED — the declared arm failed to clear the MDL
payload.falsified_if: a 24 h in-code collection on the same feed returning the Au L-beta-1 line at/below the 3-sigma MDL while the field-coupling calibration stands (Law 2396)
payload.scope_line: in-code F1 confirms the STAGE-5 loud-detection arithmetic of the instrument's own chain, bound to the real public feed; it is NOT a physical-world confirmation of the ground — the reading layer's DECLARED standing is unchanged; a real-filter collection remains available as the optional body

honesty.REAL: units, sampling chain, MDL computation, seeds, receipt chain, feed provenance
honesty.MODEL: feed->composition endmember model, forward spectrum, Poisson noise, crustal Au prior
honesty.NOT_MEASURED: every number is the declared model's output; the receipt carries the input provenance
